notes.title: New Trailer and Update Teases
notes.notes:
Hello!

Well, time flies, when you’re busy doing renovations. And renovations we did! But we’ll let the [b]brand new trailer[/b] do the talking:

[previewyoutube=8AzFZimYUTs;full][/previewyoutube]

But the Renovation Crew got not only the trailer for you today. We also would like to tease you with a stack of v[b]isual, gameplay, and sound updates[/b] that were implemented into the game:
[list]
[*] Much more [b]gore and blood[/b], left by the cultists. Or were they just teenagers?
[*] Completely reworked level design;
[*] [b]Brand new visuals[/b], courtesy of Colorfiction;
[*] Improved shaders and materials;
[*] [b]New tool models[/b]. Will there be enough space in your grandmother’s garage to store them all?
[*] Updated UI;
[*] [b]More stuff to break[/b]. Who needs a Rage Room now?
[*] New tool-based interactions with some items;
[*] [b]Stamina[/b] system;
[*] New music, voice lines and new sound effects. [b]Did I hear something just now?[/b]
[*] [b]And MUCH more![/b]
[/list]
We know that you’d love to know more about all of this, but we’d like to [b]share the inner workings behind these improvements in a proper devlog[/b]. So stay tuned for a Regular Home Renovator Simulator Semi-Regular Magazine on Renovations!

And if you yarn for physical labor, we have a game that should satisfy your needs for some time.
[b]THRESHOLD[/b] — a [b]solo horror project by Julien Eveillé[/b] (Dishonored, Hunt: Showdown), — is live now on Steam! You’re tasked with serving [i][b]your[/b][/i] country and maintaining the Border Post. But most importantly — [b]keep the train running[/b]. Remember, [b]every breath is precious[/b], so don’t waste it on asking unnecessary questions.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580020/THRESHOLD/ 

Break a leg and see you in the Renovation Crew!
